text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH3191, Ring Front Door Knocker in Polished Brass

The Brass Ring Door Knocker made by Michael Healy designs has a traditional look that is accentuated by the polished brass finish. It is thru-bolt mounted (bolts come all the way through the door and are visible from the inside) and comes with the necessary mounting hardware. This Ring Front Door Knocker is made of Sandcast Brass, meaning each piece is unique. The Polished Brass Ring Premium Size Door Knocker has a 4 inch diameter.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Traditional Ring Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Thru-Bolt Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Polished Brass Oiled Bronze

Sold Individually
